items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I think he had Louis Metcalf on trumpet

ctx.x: And this band he was rehearsing, he had Omer Sim?on, Barney Bigard and myself in the reed section. And who were the trumpets? He had a fellow named -- I can't remember, I can see him, but I can't remember the name. Paul Barbarin was on drums. Oh, I can't remember the names. But I always thought that if that had of gotten off the ground, you know, I would have liked that very much, because the people he had in the band were great jazz players, like Omer Simeon and Barney Bigard and I think he had Louis Metcalf on…
But he wrote the arrangements himself.
